|translation='''Title:''' Superlaser.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the Death Star system card at parsec 0. Use 4 Force against a capital ship at the Death Star system or a system it orbits. Draw destiny twice. A capital ship is hit if total destiny is greater than armor.

'''Lore:'''
The Death Star alone has more firepower than the entire Imperial fleet combined. Huge generators supply energy to the terrifying planet-destroying weapon.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is デス・スター用兵器.
